reviews.text: This is hands down my favorite eyebrow pencil! Shade 01 Black is my absolute favorite. It’s such a versatile shade for Asian girls, and it works beautifully with both natural black hair and dyed hair. The color looks really natural and flattering without making the brows look too harsh.
reviews.zh: 呢枝係我最愛嘅眉筆，毫無疑問！01 Black 係我絕對嘅最愛。對亞洲女仔嚟講，呢個色好百搭，無論係天然黑髮定染咗髮都好襯。色澤睇落好自然、好啱，唔會令眉毛太生硬。

reviews.text: This pencil might seem simple, but it's really good. I have black eyebrows, but I don't want to fill them in with more black, so this gray pencil gives a very natural look; it doesn't even look like it's been drawn on. It's quite long-lasting and hardly smudges unless I exercise. Being a pencil, it's very easy to keep the point sharp for applying makeup correctly.
reviews.zh: 呢枝眉筆睇落好簡單，但係真係好好。我眉毛係黑色，但唔想再加深黑色，所以呢枝灰色眉筆效果好自然，睇落好似完全冇畫過咁。持久力都幾好，除非做運動，否則好少暈開。因為係筆形，要保持筆尖尖都容易，畫得精準。

reviews.text:
This eyebrow pensil in black is the best for dark black hair. It's not too black, you are don't look like a clown. A muted black pencil goes easy on your skin, easy blends with fingers, stays all day long.
Anastasia Beverly Hills have the same one,just a lil bigger, but 40 aud$ or 6 aud$, witch one do you prefer? Haha;)
reviews.zh:
呢枝黑色眉筆最啱深黑髮。唔會太黑，唔會畫到變成小丑咁。啞光黑色眉筆對皮膚好溫和，用手指好易推開，全日都唔會脫色。
Anastasia Beverly Hills 有同款，只係大啲，價錢係 40 澳元定 6 澳元，你會揀邊個？哈哈 ;)

reviews.text: Nice little eyebrow pencil, I like the consistency. The shade didn't match me, it's quite yellowish. It's on the bottom on the pic, followed by Canmake Cinnamon Brown eyebrow pencil and Peripera Peony Ash eyebrow gel.
reviews.zh: 細細枝嘅眉筆，我好鍾意質地。個色唔啱我，偏黃少少。喺相入面係最底嗰枝，後面係 Canmake Cinnamon Brown 眉筆同 Peripera Peony Ash 眉膠。

reviews.text: i really liked this eyebrow pencil. it was perfect. I'm not the biggest fan of the brow pencils I've tried in the past. This pencil was absolutely perfect and I will be buying another one. I purchased the shade dark brown.
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢枝眉筆，完美咁啱啱好。我以前試過嘅眉筆，我都唔係好鍾意，但呢枝絕對完美，我會再買一枝。我買嘅係深啡色。

reviews.text: I didn’t have big expectations on this product since I have combo/oily skin and brow stuff doesn’t really last long on me but this one surprised me! has the perfect amount of pigment to and and a good size. will repurchase:)
reviews.zh: 我冇期望太高，因為我係混合／油性皮膚，眉部產品通常都唔持久，但呢枝令我好驚喜！色粉份量啱啱好，size 都好。會再買 :)

reviews.text: I took a chance with this since i needed to replenish my make-up bag. It's about 4-4.5 inches, its a bit smaller in size. It's alot if you think the lead size compared to my usual brow pencil,(etude drawing eyebrow) which only have 2.5 inches lead at best and it breaks to easily. The only good thing with my old eyebrow pencil since it came with a brush, but since i save and reuse that part-i wouldn't have that problem. Higly recommended, will definitely buy this again.
reviews.zh: 我試咗呢枝，因為要補充化妝袋。大約 4 至 4.5 吋，size 細少少。如果同我平時用嘅眉筆（etude drawing eyebrow）比較，佢嘅芯最多只有 2.5 吋，又好易斷，所以呢枝筆芯多咗好多。我舊眉筆有附一支刷，呢點係唯一嘅好處，但我一直有留低、重用嗰支刷，所以唔會有呢個問題。極力推薦，我一定會再買。

reviews.text: I really wish I could get this pencil in a bigger size. It works phenomenally and the color comes out dark and sharp! It's wonderful for filling in my eyebrows and when I want to draw little strokes of hair!
reviews.zh: 我真係好希望呢枝眉筆有大啲嘅 size。效果超好，色澤深、線條利落！用嚟填眉同畫細細條眉毛都好好！

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
